name: Sanatorium Purgatorium
source:
Congratulations! ° ˖✧◝ (⁰▿⁰) ◜✧˖ °
You are incredibly lucky!

You have won a week-long vacation at the new elite sanatorium Purgatorium!

Be sure, we will make you rest!
